logic: true old-balance edge break + exact aggressive-side fresh-inventory cost basis + OI persistence -> protected continuation or trapped reversal
source: official MICROBAR-SPARSE500-V5 buy/sell volume and turnover
fresh_inventory: break-direction net aggressive turnover and completed OI increase over the same completed breakout interval
cost_basis: break-direction aggressive turnover divided by break-direction aggressive volume
response: next observed packet with total turnover equal to the breakout interval turnover
